limits: Snapshots are unmodified actual C3 normal-UI saves; detached placement and full HP/MP plus 2 small potions each are explicit Lab entry conditions.
Boss fixtures use real spawnV11Boss (including two adds) and ch3:bossStart; ordinary groups use native enter/collision/AI.
Recipe comparisons craft from the SAME pre-forge snapshot with actual funds/materials and equip through production methods; no item stats are invented.
A death event counts as loss even if a projectile earns level-up healing in the same frame. Human fun/win rate is not inferred.
